essays.title: 新生欢迎会通知
paragraphs: Notice/Announcement
Friday, June 10
It is so great to hear that you, international students, have arrived at our university. This notice/announcement is for the purpose of inviting you to attend a welcome party.

To begin with, the party is scheduled to start at 19:00 on June 20 in the Center of Students’ Activities and last for approximately two hours. In addition, this party is characterized by a variety of interesting activities, including singing, dancing, Chinese culture introduction, and fun competitions. Of course, some traditional Chinese snacks will be served at the party. To conclude, it is advisable for you to participate in this party, which will bring you opportunities to make friends, arouse your passion for the campus life, and help you know China better.
Finally, we are looking forward to your participation.
The Students’ Union

Write a notice (or an announcement) in the name of the Students’ Union to (1) briefly introduce the party, and (2) invite the international students to attend it. essays.title: 推荐 AI 学习工具
paragraphs: Dear Sky,
I am quite pleased to hear that you are looking for AI tools to promote learning efficiency. Today, I am writing to make a recommendation.

It is advisable for you to try out several AI tools in learning since it is by trying them out that you can know which one can best suit your needs. A case in point is myself. As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I tried ERNIE Bot, Tongyi, and Kimi. In the end, I chose Kimi, which is characterized by its excellent performance in information collection. This AI tool can bring me high efficiency, inspire my passion for learning, and help me save time and energy.
I am looking forward to discussing more details of the AI tools after you use
them. Best wishes,
Li Ming

essays.title: 介绍同伴指导项目
paragraphs: Dear Michael,
I’m quite pleased to know that you are interested in the peer mentoring program for new students.
Today, I am writing for the purpose of introducing certain details.

This program pairs freshmen with seniors to help them adapt to college life. To begin with, college life is characterized by the fact that students have more spare time. Then, compared with high schools, there are a wider variety of campus activities, clubs and organizations in college. Thus we, as senior students, are supposed to help you develop a new pace of study and life suited for college. To conclude, it’s advisable for you to sign up for the peer mentoring program. I’m convinced that you will benefit a lot from it.
Of course, if you have any other questions, please feel free to ask me.
Yours truly,
Li Ming

paragraphs: Dear James, I am quite pleased to hear that you are coming to China and I originally planned to pick you up at the airport. However, I am writing for the purpose of making an apology since I am afraid I can’t make it. You know that during the past half year, I have been exceedingly busy because I allocated nearly all my time and energy for preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, which is of great significance to me. Then, due to my carelessness, I did not notice that the date of the test is the day when you will arrive in China until two minutes ago. Accordingly, I have no option but to ask my best friend, Sky, to pick you up at the airport this Saturday. I am deeply sorry and I plan to show you around Beijing after the test.
Best wishes,
Li Ming

essays.title: 燃油车与新能源汽车销量
paragraphs: This is a table, clearly illustrating the changes in the domestic sales of gasoline-powered and new-energy vehicles in China during the first half of 2025. In this period, the sales of new-energy cars increased steadily, from 0.79 million in January to 1.12 million in June. By contrast, the sales of gasoline cars fluctuated around 1.1 million. It is particularly noteworthy that the sales of new-energy vehicles surpassed those of gasoline-powered vehicles in May.

Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the fierce competition between new-energy vehicles and traditional cars. Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above? For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by its boom and prosperity in economy, which has enabled a host of families to possess additional income to purchase gasoline-powered or new-energy cars. For another, compared with traditional cars, new-energy vehicles are much cheaper, more eco-friendly, more efficient and require less maintenance. Thus, an increasing number of people have chosen new-energy cars.

To my understanding, China’s car manufacturers are supposed to pay more attention to the new-energy car market due to its huge potential. Meanwhile, it is advisable for them to work out comprehensive strategies to develop more types of new-energy vehicles, such as solar-powered cars.

essays.translation:
这是一张表格，清晰展示了2025年上半年中国燃油车和新能源汽车国内销量的变化。在此期间，新能源汽车的销量稳步上升，从1月的79万辆增加到6月的112万辆。相比之下，燃油车的销量在110万辆上下波动。尤其值得注意的是，新能源汽车的销量在5月份超过了燃油车。

显然，这样的数据能让人联想到新能源汽车和传统汽车之间的激烈竞争。那么，出现上述现象的原因是什么？一方面，近年来，中国的典型特征在于其经济的繁荣发展，这使得很多家庭有了额外的收入来购买燃油车或新能源汽车。另一方面，与传统汽车相比，新能源汽车更加便宜、环保、高效，需要的保养也更少。因此，越来越多的人选择了新能源汽车。

在我看来，中国的汽车制造商应该更关注新能源汽车市场，因为其潜力巨大。同时，制造商们还应制定综合策略来开发更多种类的新能源汽车，比如太阳能汽车。

essays.title: 在职群体继续学习的目的
paragraphs: Given is a bar chart, which clearly illustrates the striking contrasts in employed residents’ purposes for further study in a certain city in 2025. To be specific, enhancing current job skills ranked first, accounting for 65%. The next was acquiring knowledge in a new area, at 48%, followed by developing personal interests at 37%. Finally came gaining diplomas or vocational certificates, at 26%.

Such statistics, definitely, can be associated with the growing significance of further study after beginning one’s career. Then, what resulted in this phenomenon? For one thing, contemporary society is characterized by fierce competition and rapid technological advances, which causes employed people to have no option but to continue learning for the purpose of adapting to job requirements. A case in point is AI, as it is transforming many fields. For another, compared to the past, employed people today possess better financial conditions to pursue their interests or make up for deficiencies in educational backgrounds.

In the final analysis, I am convinced that it is advisable for everyone to develop the habit and awareness of lifelong learning, which can give us a competitive edge, inspire our passion for striving, and help us seize opportunities.

这是一幅条形图，它清楚地展示了2025年某市在职居民在继续学习目的方面的显著差异。具体来看，提升现有岗位技能位居第一，占65%。其次是学习新领域知识，占48%。发展个人兴趣紧随其后，占37%。最后是获得文凭或职业证书，占26%。

这样的数据无疑可以让人联想到，人们在工作后继续学习的重要性正与日俱增。那么，出现上述现象的原因是什么？一方面，当代社会的特点是竞争激烈与科技的迅速发展，这使在职人群为了适应岗位要求而不得不继续学习。一个典型的例子就是人工智能，它正在改变众多领域。另一方面，与过去相比，如今的在职者拥有更好的经济条件，可以追求自己的兴趣爱好，或者弥补学历方面的不足。

总而言之，我认为每个人都有必要培养终身学习的习惯和意识。终身学习能够给我们带来竞争优势，激发我们奋斗的热情，并帮助我们抓住机遇。

essays.title: 居民日常出行选择
paragraphs: Given is a column chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in residents’ daily transportation choices in a certain city in 2015 and 2021. In contrast to 2015, the percentages of people who took the bus and who drove private cars decreased in 2021, from approximately 51% and 20% to 27% and 16% respectively. Meanwhile, larger proportions of citizens chose to use online car-hailing or shared bikes, both increasing from less than 10% to nearly 25%.

Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the diversity of transportation means in contemporary society. Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above? For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the rapid development of science and technology, which has enabled a host of companies to develop more types of transportation means. For another, compared to the past years, citizens become richer and more eco-conscious. Thus, many prefer online car-hailing or shared bikes instead of crowded buses.

Therefore, the government is supposed to provide citizens with safer, more convenient, and more cost-effective modes of transportation. In addition, it is of great necessity to work out comprehensive strategies to enhance public transportation services.

所给的是一个柱状图，清晰展示了2015年和2021年某城市居民日常出行方式选择的显著差异。与2015年相比，2021年乘坐公交车和开私家车的人所占比重明显下降，分别从约51%和20%降至27%和16%。与此同时，更高比例的市民选择使用网约车或共享单车，二者均从不到10%上升到近25%。

所以，政府应该为居民提供更安全、更便捷、性价比更高的出行方式。此外，很有必要制定综合策略来提升公共交通服务。

essays.title: 大学生 AI 使用倾向
paragraphs: Given is a bar chart, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in students' purposes of utilizing AI in their studies at a certain university. To be specific, searching for and collecting materials ranks first, accounting for 75%. Then, the next is organizing writing ideas, at 67%, followed by translating or revising language, at 60%. Finally comes interpreting data or concepts, at 50%.

Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the growing significance of AI in college students' academic pursuits in reality. Then, what results in this phenomenon? For one thing, in recent years, AI tools have been characterized by diverse and powerful functions which have encouraged an increasing number of youngsters to use AI in accomplishing various academic assignments. For another, compared with traditional tools, AI can undoubtedly enhance students' learning efficiency. I am a case in point. As a youngster who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I prefer using AI to assist me in collecting materials and making plans.

In a nutshell, it is AI that enables us to enjoy tremendous convenience. However, I deem that it is not advisable for us to rely excessively on AI. We are supposed to view it as a collaborative partner rather than a replacement for human thinking.

essays.title: 平均寿命与人口老龄化
paragraphs: Given are two charts, clearly illustrating the striking changes in the average lifespan of Chinese people in 2004, 2014 and 2024, as well as the proportion of population aged 60 and above from 2004 to 2024. The left column chart shows that there was a remarkable increase in the average lifespan, from 72.54 to 79. Meanwhile, the right line chart displays that the percentage of those aged 60 and above ascended sharply, from 10.97% to 22%.

Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the trend of population aging in China. Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above? For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the economic boom and prosperity, which has enabled a growing number of people to possess additional incomes to enjoy a better quality of life and live longer. For another, compared to the past years, young people nowadays are more reluctant to marry or give birth owing to various reasons. Thus, the proportion of the elderly keeps increasing.

In a nutshell, I deem that it is advisable for the government to focus more on the challenges of population aging, such as the shortage of labor. In addition, they are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to encourage more young people to give birth to kids.

所给的是两张图表，清晰呈现了2004、2014、2024年中国人均寿命以及2004年至2024年间60岁及以上人口占比的显著变化。左侧柱状图显示人均寿命从72.54岁显著增长至79岁。同时，右侧折线图表明60岁及以上人口比例从10.97%急剧上升至22%。

简而言之，我认为政府应该更加关注人口老龄化带来的挑战，如劳动力短缺问题。此外，他们应该制定综合策略来鼓励更多年轻人生育。

essays.title: 大学生初次求职考虑因素
paragraphs: Presented is a pie chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in factors that college students at a university take into consideration during their first job hunting in 2025. To be specific, salaries ranked first, accounting for 28%. The next was the opportunity for improvement, at 25%, followed by job duties, at 23%. Finally came job stability and work locations, at 16% and 8% respectively.

Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the significance young people attach to their first jobs in reality. Then, what resulted in this phenomenon? To begin with, college graduates are characterized by the fact that they have become adults and need to earn their own bread, which makes them consider the salary as the first factor. In addition, young people are also marked by their strong desire to improve themselves and put what they have learned into practice. Thus, opportunities and job duties are of great importance to them.

As a youngster, I deem that when we hunt for jobs, it is advisable for us to first consider those positions that can provide opportunities to acquire new skills, which definitely can inspire our passion for challenging ourselves, help us enhance our overall competence, and give us better prospects for promotion.

作为一名年轻人，我认为我们求职时应首先考虑那些能够提供新技能学习机会的岗位，这些岗位无疑能够激发我们挑战自我的热情，帮助我们提高综合能力，并为我们带来良好的晋升前景。

essays.title: 公共场所无障碍通道
paragraphs: The left drawing shows a simple but quite warm scene, in which there is a disabled person, using a wheelchair to move easily along an accessible pathway. Meanwhile, the right chart clearly illustrates that in a certain city, from 2021 to 2025, the proportion of public places equipped with accessible pathways increased remarkably, from 56% to 85%.

The scene and statistics above, apparently, can be associated with the special care for people with disabilities in real life. Then, what resulted in this phenomenon? In recent years, China has been characterized by its economic boom and prosperity, which has enabled the government to devote more financial budgets to public facilities, including accessible pathways. It is these facilities that ensure people with limited mobility to enjoy tremendous convenience and get around independently. To my mind, this special care can be likened to sunshine, which can bring warmth to those in need, inspire their passion for life, and help us build a civilized society.

In the final analysis, I deem that it is advisable for the government to build more accessible pathways in public places. Meanwhile, society as a whole is supposed to foster a positive atmosphere to care for, love, and protect those with disabilities and the like.

essays.translation:
左图展示了一个简单却十分温暖的场景：一位残障人士正在无障碍通道上轻松地使用轮椅移动。与此同时，右图清楚地显示，在某市，从2021年到2025年，配备无障碍通道的公共场所的比例显著上升，从56%提高到了85%。

显然，上述场景和数据能让人联想到现实生活中对残障人士的特殊关爱。那么，出现这种现象的原因是什么？近年来，中国的特点在于其经济繁荣昌盛，这使政府能够投入更多财政预算，用在包括无障碍通道在内的公共设施上。正是这些设施让行动不便的人获得巨大便利，得以独立出行。在我看来，这种特殊关爱可以比作阳光，它能给有需要的人带来温暖，激发他们对生活的热情，并帮助我们建设文明社会。

总而言之，我认为政府应该在公共场所建设更多无障碍通道。同时，全社会都应营造积极氛围，关心、关爱并保护残障人士以及其他类似群体。

essays.title: 急救知识的普及
paragraphs: In the left drawing, there is a professional healthcare worker, imparting first aid knowledge to two youngsters. Meanwhile, the right chart clearly illustrates that from 2021 to 2025, in a certain city, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 who attended first aid courses ascended significantly, from 9% to 32%.

The scene and statistics above, definitely, can be associated with a positive shift in public awareness regarding safety and health. Undoubtedly, in recent decades, China has been characterized by its economic prosperity and technological advancement, which have enabled people to enjoy a higher quality of life and have more opportunities to acquire various kinds of knowledge, including first aid skills. It is mastering basic first aid skills that enables citizens to save their own or others’ lives in emergencies, such as cardiac arrests, accidents. I am a case in point. As a youngster, I prefer watching health education videos and TV programs, as well as attending medical lectures to acquire first aid knowledge. Thanks to such knowledge, I helped save an injured man after a car accident.

In a nutshell, I am convinced that it is advisable for hospitals to offer more free training courses to people from all walks of life. Meanwhile, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to inspire the public to learn these vital skills.

essays.translation:
左图中，一名专业医护人员正在向两名年轻人传授急救知识。与此同时，右图清楚地显示，从2021年到2025年，某市18~60岁居民中参加过急救课程的比例显著上升，从9%提高到了32%。

显然，上述场景和数据能让人联想到公众在安全与健康意识方面的积极转变。毫无疑问，近几十年来，中国的特点是经济繁荣和科技进步，这使人们能够享受更高质量的生活，并有更多机会获取包括急救技能在内的各种知识。正是掌握基础急救技能使居民能够在心脏骤停、意外事故等紧急情况下挽救自己或他人的生命。我就是一个典型的例子。作为年轻人，我喜欢观看健康教育视频和电视节目，也喜欢参加医学讲座，以学习急救知识。多亏了这些知识，我曾在一次车祸后救助了一名伤者。

总而言之，我认为医院应该向各行各业的人提供更多免费培训课程。同时，整个社会也应营造积极的氛围，鼓励公众学习这些至关重要的技能。

essays.title: 科技改变习惯
paragraphs: These are two simple but satirical drawings. In the left picture, there is a girl, sitting in front of a computer and typing so many words with no difficulty. However, in the right cartoon, without the help of modern technology, the girl has great trouble in writing words on paper, with the thought in her mind: I need to look them up on my cell phone. Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed below the pictures, which read that science and technology has changed people’s habits.

The fast development of science and technology, to my understanding, can be likened to a double-edged sword. On the one hand, numerous innovative technological products can bring us great convenience, inspire our passion for a promising life, and help us enhance work efficiency. On the other hand, it is modern technology that causes a number of youngsters to lose certain basic skills in life, work, and study. This phenomenon is particularly worth attention.
As a college student, I deem that it is advisable for us to utilize modern technological products, but it is of no necessity to be slaves to IT products.

在我看来，科学技术的飞速发展可以比作一把双刃剑。一方面，众多的创新科技产品能给我们带来巨大的便利，激发我们对美好生活的热情，并帮助我们提高工作效率。另一方面，正是现代科技使一些年轻人丧失了生活、工作和学习中的某些基本技能。这一现象非常值得关注。

作为一名大学生，我认为我们应该使用现代科技产品，但没必要完全依赖IT产品。

essays.title: 奖励式教育
paragraphs: This is a simple but enlightening excerpt of an article, in which the author argues that incentive-based parenting can be effective at home for the short term, but will become a problem in the long run. Although I have no children, I couldn’t agree more with it.

To my understanding, one’s internal motivation can be likened to the key to success. A case in point is myself. As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I cling to the idea that it is inner motivation that enables me to work hard each day and accumulate adequate knowledge and competence to achieve my dream. However, in reality, a host of short-sighted parents may merely rely on the so-called reward system to encourage their children. This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that children often fail to maintain positive behaviors if the reward is unavailable. That is to say, in the long term, this sort of reward system may constitute an obstacle that hinders youngsters’ growth and progress.

Accordingly, all parents should bear in mind that internal motivation cultivates interest in learning itself. If parents intend to see children’s sustainable growth, it is advisable for them to inspire the young’s internal motivation.

这是一段简单但具有启发性的文章节选，作者在文中指出，短期来看，这种奖励式教育在家里是有效的，但从长远来看会引发问题。虽然我没有孩子，但我完全同意。

在我看来，一个人的内在动力可以比作通往成功的钥匙。一个典型的例子就是我自己。作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我坚信，正是内在动力让我可以每天刻苦学习，积累足够的知识和能力来实现梦想。然而，在现实生活中，许多目光短浅的父母可能只依靠所谓的奖励机制来鼓励孩子。这种现象特别值得关注，因为如果没有奖励，孩子们往往无法保持积极的行为。也就是说，从长远来看，这种奖励机制可能会构成一种障碍，阻碍年轻人的成长和进步。

因此，所有家长都应牢记，内在动力培养的是对学习本身的兴趣。如果父母想看到孩子不断成长，就应该激发孩子的内在动力。

essays.title: 附录样题：青少年社交与科技
essays.type: 材料作文 · 大纲模拟样题
paragraphs: Given is a simple but enlightening excerpt of an article, which clearly illustrates the result of studies in the U.S. and the U.K.: children have lost the right to wander and thus, they turn to technology to socialize, relax and learn. As a youngster, I agree with this argument.

Admittedly, compared to the past years, children enjoy less space and freedom to wander, especially in cities, where traffic is busy and skyscrapers are everywhere. Even in city parks, children are still followed and protected by parents. However, as the studies show, children are fond of interacting with their peers rather than their parents. A case in point is myself. As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I do not prefer discussing my problems in learning with my parents or siblings. Instead, I tend to release my stress by listening to music, chatting with friends or playing games on smartphones.

Accordingly, it is advisable for parents to give children the right to wander. Meanwhile, parents are supposed to guide their kids to use technology in a rational way because some of them may be addicted to video games.
essays.prompt:
Read the following excerpt from an article and write an essay. In your essay, you should explain whether or to what extent you agree with the author. Support your argument with reasons and relevant examples.
Write your answer in about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)

Studies in the U.S. and the U.K. consistently show that children have lost the right to wander. This is why many of our youth turn to technology. They aren't addicted to the computer; they're addicted to interaction, and being around their friends. Children, and especially teenagers, don't want to only socialize with parents and siblings; they want to play with their peers. That's how they make sense of the world. And we've robbed them of that opportunity. We're raising our children in captivity and they turn to technology to socialize, learn and relax. Why are we blaming the screens?
essays.translation:
所给是一篇文章的节选，简单却很有启发性。节选内容清楚地表明了美国和英国的研究结果：孩子们失去了闲逛的权利，因而开始使用科技产品进行社交、放松和学习。作为一个年轻人，我同意这一观点。

确实，与过去相比，孩子们闲逛的空间和自由变得更少，尤其是在交通拥堵、高楼林立的城市中。即使在城市公园里，孩子们也仍旧有父母跟随保护。然而，研究表明，孩子喜欢跟同龄人交流，而非父母。一个典型的例子就是我自己。作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我不喜欢与父母或兄弟姐妹聊学习问题。相反，我倾向于通过听音乐、与朋友聊天或者在手机上玩游戏来释放压力。

因此，建议家长给孩子出去闲逛的权利。同时，家长也应该引导孩子理性地使用科技产品，因为有些孩子可能会沉迷于电子游戏。
cues: 概述材料并表明观点
城市空间、同伴交流与个人事例
给予自由并引导理性使用科技
